root_cause.text: The ibmasm driver's ibmasm_handle_mouse_interrupt function fails to validate hardware-provided queue reader and writer indices against REMOTE_QUEUE_SIZE before computing MMIO addresses, allowing out-of-bounds memory-mapped I/O reads.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description identifies that get_queue_entry() computes queue_begin + reader * sizeof(struct remote_input) with no bounds check on raw readl() values, and the patch diff confirms the fix by adding an explicit bounds check if (reader >= REMOTE_QUEUE_SIZE || writer >= REMOTE_QUEUE_SIZE) before calling get_queue_entry().
